mapper.select: SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId,c.name,c.color,COALESCE(a.attempts,0) AS attempts FROM practice_categories c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.category_id,COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=pa.exercise_id WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} GROUP BY e.category_id ) a ON a.category_id=c.category_id WHERE c.active=TRUE ORDER BY c.sort_order

SELECT e.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.category_id AS categoryId,e.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=pa.exercise_id WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC,pa.attempt_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT he.exercise_id FROM homework_exercises he JOIN homeworks h ON h.homework_id=he.homework_id WHERE h.student_id=#{studentId} AND h.status<>'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homeworks WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND status<>'COMPLETED'

SELECT e.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.title,e.category_id AS categoryId FROM exercises e WHERE e.category_id=#{categoryId} AND e.active=TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM practice_attempts pa WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} AND pa.exercise_id=e.exercise_id)
AND (e.sort_order > #{afterSortOrder} OR (e.sort_order = #{afterSortOrder} AND e.exercise_id > #{afterExerciseId}))
AND e.exercise_id NOT IN #{id}
ORDER BY e.sort_order,e.exercise_id LIMIT 1
